# Would electric vans save your fleet money?

> Free fleet EV vs diesel cost calculator: purchase, chargers, energy, demand charges, maintenance, insurance and resale in; year-by-year cost, payback, break-even fuel price and mileage, a sensitivity grid and a range check out. Nothing uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
